text.p: Northstar Health Services Inc said Thursday it reached a preliminary settlement, which will resolve all of the eight shareholder suits currently pending against the company, if confirmed.
The company said The suits, originally seeking more than $20 million in damages, were filed following its discovery of accounting irregularities in early 1996.

The company's portion of the proposed $6.45 million settlement fund will be covered by its director and officer liability insurance, with other parties and their insurers funding the balance, Northstar said.
The discoveries led to the resignations of its Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Mark DeSimone, its executive vice president and an outside director.
Northstar said final judicial confirmation of these settlements is scheduled for November 7.
